# Module: `icescopy_droplet_tools`

Connects neural droplet detection to the toolbar, frame state, and cell history.

[Source](../src/icescopy_droplet_tools.py) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

Copies original frame pixels and circle geometry before starting a worker. When detection finishes, checks that the source and cell state still match the snapshot, filters proposed circles, and inserts the accepted cells as one undoable edit.

## Classes

| Class | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [`DetectionSnapshot`](API-Class-DetectionSnapshot.md) | Holds the frame pixels, guidance circles, and geometry captured for one detection run. |
| [`DetectionWorker`](API-Class-DetectionWorker.md) | Runs neural detection on a captured frame in a Qt worker thread. |
| [`DropletDetectionTools`](API-Class-DropletDetectionTools.md) | Owns the detection action, model configuration, worker, and result insertion. |
